text:
tess: Heads-up — noticed the KB explainer for the 'kv-cache' page has an animated GIF that 404s. It was linked from S3 and the bucket path changed. Can someone swap to the static screenshot and do a quick QA?

chris: I can take this. which file is it?

tess: docs/kb/kv-cache-explainer.md — the image ref is `![](https://s3.redwood.example/kv-cache/gif/latest.gif)` and should be `assets/kv-cache-screenshot-202602.png` in the repo.

chris: cool. I'll replace with the screenshot and open a PR. planning to keep the GIF removed for now so it doesn't rot again.

ana: quick note — the GIF also shows the old CLI flags (`--fast-mode`) that got renamed last quarter. If the screenshot shows that, ping me to take a look before merge.

chris: thanks @ana — good catch. The screenshot I'm planning to add is generated from the current CLI, so should be correct. I'll paste the sed command I used to patch locally:

```
# replace hosted S3 GIF with local asset path
sed -i 's|https://s3.redwood.example/kv-cache/gif/latest.gif|/assets/kv-cache-screenshot-202602.png|g' docs/kb/kv-cache-explainer.md
```

jonathan: FYI docs-bot will pick up the PR and run the static asset linter. If linter throws an alt text warning, please add descriptive alt text like `alt="KV cache dashboard showing hit rate"`.

chris: opened PR: https://git.redwood.local/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4321 — includes the screenshot, updated alt text, and a one-line note in the changelog.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #4321 — image-size-check, markdown-lint, link-check.

ana: reviewed the screenshot — no old flags visible. small nit: the console font size is larger than other images. can you shrink it so it's consistent?

chris: will do. patching now and pushing.

chris: done, pushed force-update to the branch.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4321.

tess: awesome, thanks @chris @ana. Once merged can someone drop a quick note in the release notes channel so support doesn't triage incoming tickets to the GIF path?

jonathan: I'll add a small note to #announcements/release-notes after the merge.

chris: merged and deleted branch. link to commit: https://git.redwood.local/r/redwood/docs/commit/9f3a2b1

tess: perfect. closing the loop — thanks everyone :tada:

chris: np :thumbsup:
